name: reactor-mode-3a-field-just-after-menu
description: #81 (M2 exit, mode-detection set): a point just after a transition. The script waits for the first frame g_GameState reads 1 (field), marks it, then waits 60 frames with no input. Checks the raw inputs semantic/layer.js mode() reads (owner decision on #81, 2026-11-18): g_GameState still reads 1 (mode_ok) and did not change since the mark (held), g_PrevGameState reads menu 5 (prev_ok), and Stframe_no did not change since the mark (no_movie: mode() reports field, not movie). From menu-open, Cross every second until field, as reactor-mode-3-menu-close does. match: a rerun.
